tasks.label: TZ: configure
tasks.detail: Configure CMake for the TrustZone demo (build/Debug/)

tasks.label: TZ: unlock debug if needed
tasks.detail: No-op on Open boards or if already unlocked; otherwise debug-auth unlock at HDPL1 until power-off

tasks.label: TZ: verify option bytes
tasks.detail: Verify that the board's option bytes (TZEN, SECWM*, etc) match expected. If not, prompt user to fix them.

tasks.label: TZ: flash
tasks.command: STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD mode=HotPlug ap=1 -w Secure/build/sec_flash_demo_s.elf -w NonSecure/build/sec_flash_demo_ns.elf -rst
tasks.detail: Flash both images over HotPlug, which reaches a provisioned part after the DA unlock and reproduces the CubeProgrammer secure-flash bug there
